description: Labcorp Holdings Inc. is a global leader of innovative and comprehensive laboratory services that provides vital information to help doctors, hospitals, pharmaceutical companies, researchers and patients make clear and confident decisions, providing insights and accelerating innovations to improve health and improve lives through its unparalleled diagnostics and drug development laboratory capabilities. During 2025 its nearly 71,000 employees served clients in approximately 100 countries and performed more than 750 million tests for patients around the world, and the company provided support for more than 85 percent of the new drugs and therapeutic products approved in 2025 by the FDA. It focuses on four primary specialty testing areas that it believes represent significant growth areas: oncology, women's health, autoimmune disease, and neurology.
